title: erigeron alexeenkoi
intro: Erigeron alexeenkoi, commonly known as Russian dwarf coneflower, is a perennial plant species native to the Russian Far East. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron alexeenkoi include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in wound healing and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
